home.heroLede: YUnited is a student club at the University of St. Gallen connecting students with roots from former Yugoslavia — and anyone curious about the culture — socially and professionally. Since 2013.
home.whoBody: From Prvi Maj barbecues to karaoke nights and career networks — YUnited hosts social and professional events that help students feel at home in St. Gallen and build friendships that last well beyond graduation.

events.heroLede: Brunches, barbecues, karaoke, casino nights and career events — this is what we get up to. Members get access to all events via uniclubs.
events.pastIntro: A look back at what we've done recently. Photos and stories also live on our Instagram.
events.emptyUpcomingHeading: The next event isn't announced yet.
events.emptyUpcomingBody: The board sets the semester's programme in the first weeks of term. Follow along and you'll hear about it first.

about.heroLede: Fostering cultural exchange between students from former Yugoslavia at the University of St. Gallen — since 2013.
about.missionP1: YUnited connects students with roots from former Yugoslavia socially and professionally while fostering cultural exchange at the University of St. Gallen.
about.missionP2: We host a variety of social and professional events for students from ex-Yugoslav countries to aid in their personal and professional development during and after their studies at HSG — and everyone interested in the culture is welcome, whether or not your roots are in the region.
about.missionP3: Beyond campus, YUnited builds a network between students, supports their academic development, acts as a bridge to companies and organisations with an ex-Yugoslav background, and supports and promotes fundraising campaigns.
about.missionP4: Our buddy-system offers guidance for assessment and exchange students while fostering connections across all majors and semesters.
about.buddyHeading: Someone to ask, from day one
about.buddyLede: Starting at HSG is a lot at once — a new city, a new system, a lot of new people. Our buddy system pairs you with someone who has already been through it. It is open to every YUnited member, not only to students arriving on exchange.
about.buddyStudentsBody: Assessment-year students get a first point of contact for the things no handbook covers — how to plan a semester, which courses go well together, where to find things. It also connects students across majors and year groups, from assessment through to master's.
about.buddyExchangeBody: Here for a semester? Your buddy is a friendly first contact for questions about HSG and everyday life in St. Gallen — no Balkan roots required.
about.buddyMorePre: There is more detail on what we offer incoming and outgoing students on the
about.buddyTeaser: Starting at HSG is a lot at once. Our buddy system pairs you with another member who has already been through it — sign up, and the board matches everyone at the start of term.
about.storyIntro: YUnited was founded in 2013 as the cultural club for students from the ex-Yugoslav region at HSG.
about.valueCommunityBody: A home away from home: friendships across all majors and semesters, from the Assessment year to Master's and beyond.
about.valueCultureBody: Keeping the food, music, humour and traditions of the region alive in St. Gallen — and sharing them with everyone who's curious.
about.valueCareersBody: Professional events and a bridge to companies and organisations with ex-Yugoslav roots, during your studies and after them.

exchange.incomingLede: Spending a semester in St. Gallen? You're warmly invited — no Balkan roots required.

exchange.incomingEvents: Events: join our brunches, barbecues, karaoke and party nights from week one. Membership (via uniclubs) gives access to all events.
exchange.incomingHome: A taste of home: if your roots are in the region, we're a way to stay connected to the culture while abroad. If not, we're a fun way to discover it.

partners.heroLede: We connect HSG students with roots from former Yugoslavia — and everyone curious about the culture — socially and professionally. Here's how a partnership works.
partners.reachBody: YUnited has run social and professional events for HSG students since 2013, connecting a community that spans every major and semester.
partners.visibilityBody: Partners are featured at our events and across our website and social media, in front of an engaged, close-knit audience.

join.heroLede: Membership is handled entirely on uniclubs.ch — the official HSG club platform. Sign up there in a couple of minutes; this website is just here to tell you why it's worth it.
join.semesterBody: Access to all YUnited events for the year: brunches, barbecues, karaoke, adventures, career events and more.

join.note: You'll need to sign in with your uniclubs account. Payment and membership administration all happen on uniclubs — we never handle it on this site.

buddy.heroTitle: Someone to ask, from day one
buddy.heroLede: Starting at HSG is a lot at once — a new city, a new system, a lot of new people. A buddy is someone who has already been through it. Open to every YUnited member, not only students arriving on exchange.
buddy.whatHeading: One person to point you in the right direction
buddy.whatLede: We pair you with another member — by chance, not by algorithm — who answers the questions no handbook covers and introduces you to a few people.
buddy.whatP1: For HSG students. Assessment-year students get a first point of contact for planning a semester, choosing courses that go together, and finding their way around campus — across majors and year groups, from the Assessment year through to Master's.
buddy.whatP2: For exchange students. Here for a semester? Your buddy is a friendly first contact for questions about HSG and everyday life in St. Gallen. No Balkan roots required.
buddy.whatP3: How the match is made. You sign up and confirm your email. At the start of term the board runs a matching round over everyone in the pool — usually once, with a second round for later signups.
buddy.whatP4: By chance, with a fallback. Everyone is paired at random. If there aren't enough buddies, the ones who offered to take an extra person get one. Anyone still unmatched is held for the next round, never forced onto an unwilling buddy.
buddy.whatP5: Then it's yours. You both get an email with a private link to your pair page — names, contact details and a short checklist to get the first meeting to happen.
buddy.studentsBody: A first person to ask about course planning, campus and how things actually work — well beyond what any handbook covers.
buddy.exchangeBody: A friendly contact for HSG and daily life in St. Gallen, for the one semester you're here.
buddy.promptTitle: Read enough? Add yourself to the pool.
buddy.promptBody: About a minute. You can change or cancel any time.
buddy.signupHeading: Be a buddy, or be matched with one
buddy.roleBuddyHint: I've been at HSG a while and can show someone the ropes.
buddy.roleSeekerHint: I'm new here and would like someone to ask.
buddy.fieldEmailHelp: We send a confirmation link here, then your match. Your address is only shared with the person you're paired with.
buddy.audienceHsg: An HSG student (Assessment, Bachelor or Master)
buddy.audienceExchange: An incoming exchange student, here for a semester
buddy.fieldLanguagesHelp: Shown to your match so you can pick a common language. Not used for matching.
buddy.fieldCapacity: How many people are you happy to buddy?
buddy.fieldExtra: If we're short on buddies, give me an extra person beyond that number.
buddy.fieldNotePlaceholder: What you're studying, what you're hoping to get out of it, anything your buddy should know.
buddy.fieldNoteHelp: Your buddy sees this. It's a conversation starter, nothing more.
buddy.consentShare: Share my name, email and study info with the person I'm matched with.
buddy.submitNote: Confirm your email and you're in until the next round. One-click unsubscribe in every message.
buddy.formError: Please fill in the highlighted fields before sending.
buddy.formFallback: Sorry — something went wrong. Please email us at yunited@shsg.ch and we'll add you by hand.
buddy.formSuccessBody: We've sent a confirmation link to {email}. Click it and you're in the pool for the next round. The link works once and expires in 48 hours. If it's not there in a minute, check your spam or junk folder.
buddy.checkEmailBody: We've sent you a confirmation link. Click it and you're in the pool for the next round. The link works once and expires in 48 hours. If it's not there in a minute, check your spam or junk folder.
buddy.faqQ1: Do I have to be a member?
buddy.faqA1: The buddy system is for YUnited members. Joining takes a couple of minutes on uniclubs.ch — there is a free tier if you just want to try us out first.
buddy.faqA2: The board runs a matching round at the start of each semester, and a smaller one a few weeks later for anyone who signed up late. You will get an email the moment you are paired.
buddy.faqQ3: What if the match is not a fit?
buddy.faqA3: Your pair page has a “something's not working” button. Tell us and we will re-pair you in the next round — no awkwardness needed.
buddy.faqA4: Every email we send has a one-click link to leave the pool. Your details are deleted when you do.
buddy.confirmedBody: Your email is confirmed. The next matching round runs at the start of term — you'll get an email the moment you're paired. Nothing else to do.
buddy.removedBody: You're no longer in the buddy pool and won't get any more emails. Changed your mind? Just sign up again.
buddy.pairError: This link didn't work. It may have expired, or been mistyped. Check the most recent email we sent you, or get in touch.
buddy.pairRoleSeeker: Your buddy (looking for one — that's you helping!)
buddy.pairStep1: Send a first hello by email
buddy.pairStep2: Meet for a coffee in the first two weeks
buddy.pairStep3: Swap numbers or add each other on WhatsApp
buddy.pairPrompt1: What's the one thing you wish someone had told you in your first month?
buddy.pairPrompt2: Which courses actually go well together?
buddy.pairPrompt3: Where does everyone go between lectures?
buddy.pairConfirmText: Been in touch? Let the board know it's working.
buddy.pairFlagDone: Thanks for telling us. We'll re-pair you in the next round.
